# Media + Text

`layout/media-text` &middot; section-level &middot; category: layout

## Purpose

An image beside text (image left or right) that stacks on mobile.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | image { src, alt } |  |
| `content` | components (content-level) |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Image on the left, text on the right. The image is first on mobile.
- **image-right**: Text on the left, image on the right. The image is still first on mobile. Sets `imagePosition: right`.
- **large-image**: A larger image (60/40) on the left. Sets `split: 60/40`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mobileLayout` | one of `stack`, `reverse` | `"stack"` |
| `mobileAlignment` | one of `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right` | `"inherit"` |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.surface"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX @theme.section.paddingY @theme.section.paddingX"` |
| `imagePosition` | one of `left`, `right` | `"left"` |
| `split` | text | `"45/55"` |
| `valign` | one of `top`, `middle`, `bottom` | `"middle"` |
| `columnPadding` | spacing | `"0 @spacing.sm"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `mobileLayout`: `stack`, `reverse`. How columns arrange on phones (stack keeps order, reverse puts the last first, preserve keeps them side by side).
- `mobileAlignment`: `inherit`, `left`, `center`, `right`. Overrides text alignment below 480px (`inherit` keeps the desktop alignment). Best effort, images depend on the client.
- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Side by side as a table row. Mobile order setting only affects phones. | Stacking works. Gmail on non-Google accounts shows the desktop layout on phones. | Swaps via dm-* classes when on the brand surface or background color. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('layout/media-text', {
  "media": {
    "src": "https://placehold.co/560x480/png?text=Studio",
    "alt": "A ceramic mug on a wooden shelf beside a plant"
  },
  "content": [
    {
      "component": "content/heading",
      "data": {
        "text": "Handmade in small batches"
      },
      "settings": {
        "level": "h2"
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/text",
      "data": {
        "text": "Every mug is thrown, glazed and fired by hand in our Portland studio, so no two are exactly alike."
      }
    },
    {
      "component": "content/button",
      "data": {
        "label": "Meet the makers",
        "href": "https://example.com/pages/about"
      }
    }
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

